items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: Elmore Alexander on the drums I worked with Benny in the Waldorf Astoria. That was another hectic thing. Every night he fired somebody.

ctx.x: And what sort of response did you get?

Very nice. The only thin, when we got there you know they took all our names off the passport, our passports. Well you know, you didn't know who was who. Nobody knew I'm trumpeter Wilbur Clayton. (LAUGHTER). And all of those names nobody knew who in the heck was all these funny names. They just took the whole names off of the passport and put them up on the wall. Somebody was called Mousey Alexander, we found out his name was Elmore. (LAUGHTER?). Elmore Alexander on the drums I worked with Benny in the Waldorf…
